NOAA PSL 20CRv3 ensemble-mean mean sea-level pressure, 2005-02-16 06:00 UTC.

Source: https://psl.noaa.gov/thredds/dodsC/Datasets/20thC_ReanV3/miscMO/prmsl.2005.nc.ascii?prmsl%5B370:1:370%5D%5B0:1:180%5D%5B0:1:359%5D

The `.ascii.gz` fixture is a deterministic, lossless gzip of that complete single-time response. Units are Pa; latitude is -90 to +90 and longitude 0 to359 at 1° increments. No storm observations are embedded in the pressure field.

Independent QA with ContourPy 1.4 and geodesic radial intersections:

- Olaf minimum: 12°S,171°W. At1000mb the mean contour radius is325.3651nmi.
- At1002mb, the mean radius is429.8965nmi; minimum297.738, maximum608.725nmi.
- At1004mb, the closed loop includes both Olaf and Nancy. Thus the fixed2mb isolated-contour method selects1002mb, approximately430nmi.
- A separate direct bilinear-pressure/geodesic-ray calculation gives430.335nmi at1002mb. Numerical agreement does not imply observational precision at the source grid scale.

Data provided by NOAA PSL, Boulder,Colorado,USA. NOAA/CIRES/DOE Twentieth Century Reanalysis version3, supported by U.S.DOE Office of Science, NOAA Climate Program Office,and NOAA Physical Sciences Laboratory.

Regression grids added for Durian (2006-11-29 12Z) and Haiyan (2013-11-07 12Z), from the same NOAA OPeNDAP source and 1-degree coordinate grid. Their next 1010-mb contours are open on the complete periodic global domain, not merely clipped by the regional analysis window. Independent full-global ContourPy validation finds the last closed contour at 1008 mb for both: Durian mean radius 291.773566 nmi about 13N127E; Haiyan 464.024661 nmi about 10N129E. An open next isobar is a valid outer-isobar termination and does not require merging with another low.

`noaa-prmsl-20061129T1200Z.nc.gz` is a lossless gzip of the official plotting-page numeric subset. It is generated by `/cgi-bin/mddb2/plot.pl` with `doplot=0`, variable `prmsl`, varID `142214`, matching start/end 2006-11-29 12Z, units Pa, and global bounds. This is the page's documented “Url to Generate Subset” flow. It avoids the separate THREDDS ASCII endpoint while returning the same pressure field (differences at most 0.0025 Pa from ASCII text rounding). NetCDF4 dimensions: time1,lat181,lon360. Time is hours since 1800-01-01 00Z, with lat -90..90 and lon 0..359. Production reads this subset alongside the chart generated by the same original NOAA service.

`noaa-prmsl-20131107T1800Z.nc.gz` is a lossless gzip of the same official numeric-subset service at Haiyan 2013-11-07 18Z. The 1008-mb global contour connects Haiyan to a distinct low at 20S,126E outside the regional analysis window. The final isolated 1006-mb contour has mean radius approximately 575 nmi. These reanalysis-derived quantities are independent of the same-time USA-reported 1000 mb / 220 nmi. The earlier 12Z reported pair is 1003 mb / 200 nmi; values from different times must not be combined.

Global-continuation regressions use lossless, unchanged NOAA numeric-subset responses at Zeb 1998-10-13 18Z (`noaa-prmsl-19981013T1800Z.nc.gz`) and Rita 1978-10-23 06Z (`noaa-prmsl-19781023T0600Z.nc.gz`). Both requests use the same `doplot=0`, variable ID 142214 flow above with the corresponding dates/times. These cases previously stopped at the regional chart boundary even though the next isobar remained closed farther away.

Independent ContourPy 1.4.0 contours on the full periodic longitude grid, followed by a separate NumPy geodesic radial-intersection calculation, give:

- Zeb: 1008 mb about the 17N,124E grid minimum; mean 787.6138117 nmi, minimum 345.3148999 nmi, maximum 2607.1385269 nmi. The 1010-mb isobar is open on the global chart.
- Rita: 1010 mb about the 12N,147E grid minimum; mean 1476.4501165 nmi, minimum 409.5560658 nmi, maximum 3046.9061317 nmi. The next 1012-mb contour encloses a distinct low at 16N,206E; the selected 1010-mb contour does not.

The wide ranges reflect broad and asymmetric reanalysis pressure basins. Agreement verifies this contour algorithm, not agreement with an agency's observed cyclone size or POCI. The extractor labels these as reanalysis estimates and preserves reported agency values separately. A global basin whose mean radius exceeds the estimator's 1500-nmi input range remains unresolved instead of being truncated to the regional chart.

Gay 1992 chart-spacing regression: `noaa-prmsl-19921121T0000Z.nc.gz` stores an unchanged, losslessly gzipped original NOAA numeric subset for 1992-11-21 00Z. The USA track fix is 11.2N,155.8E; the grid minimum is at12N,156E. The1005mb contour has mean radius248.6313nmi using360 geodesic bearing intersections. The finer1008mb contour has mean radius377.4425nmi. The1010mb line joins another distinct low. Default API extraction now selects5mb spacing and requests the same spacing from NOAA's chart service (`contourLevel=custom`, `cint=500`Pa, limits derived from the actual grid). The optional2mb mode is distinct and labels its interval. Extra decimal places describe reproducible geometry, not observed ROCI precision. Previous2mb benchmark tests remain explicit.
